core.title: 28 to 36-inch Grade 1 Door Surface Vertical Rod 8400 Series

text.description_html:
8400 Series Surface Vertical Rod

Tell Manufacturing, Inc. was incorporated in 1986 as a manufacturer and distributor of commercial locks and door hardware. Tell has expanded its customer profiles to include, contract hardware distribution, locksmith distributors, OEM manufacturers, and the modular office industry.

8400 Series Vertical Rod:
* Non handed
* Door thickness 1 3/4" standard for wood or hollow metal
* Backset standard 2 3/4"
* Rail size standard to fit 28" to 36" doors. Easily field sizable.
* Optional 48" rail available for wider doors.
* Pullman latch bolts top and bottom stainless steel 1/2" throw
* Strike black powder coated surface applied to frame and threshold
* Covers 160/161 door cut out
* Hex key dogging standard on non fire labeled devices
* Rods furnished standard to fit 7'0" high door
* Confirms to ANSI A156.3, 1994 Grade 1
* Optional outside trims available
* Fasteners accommodate wood or metal doors
